profile.headline: Senior Front-End Developer & WordPress Architect | Custom WordPress, WooCommerce, Accessibility, Web Performance & Marketing Technology
profile.summary:
I build and improve business-critical websites that are reliable, maintainable, and easier for marketing teams to manage.
 
I have 17+ years of agency experience building, modernizing, and supporting websites for enterprise and mid-market clients. My background includes front-end development, WordPress architecture, accessibility, performance, ecommerce, CMS implementation, and marketing technology.
 
I’ve developed custom WordPress themes, reusable templates and components, ACF content structures, landing pages, forms, ecommerce workflows, and third-party integrations using PHP, HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, WooCommerce, Elementor, HubSpot, Pardot, GA4, GTM, and related tools.
 
Much of my work involves websites that have become slow, difficult to maintain, or weighed down by technical debt. I’m comfortable stepping into an existing site, figuring out what is causing problems, improving the underlying code, and making the platform more dependable for the people who use it every day.
 
Recent work includes supporting a headless Shopify storefront built with Hydrogen, React, and TypeScript; improving Core Web Vitals; remediating accessibility issues across large websites; and developing custom ecommerce functionality for complex business requirements.
 
I’m currently open to remote senior-level roles in front-end development, WordPress, web platforms, CMS development, and marketing web technology.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer & WordPress Consultant
positions.locationName: Fort Worth, Texas, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Provide part-time and project-based web development and technical consulting for businesses, agencies, and ecommerce teams. This work ran alongside my full-time agency career and now continues as an independent practice.
 
• Build, maintain, and improve custom WordPress websites, themes, templates, landing pages, forms, and reusable components using PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, ACF, and related tools.
 • Support inherited and business-critical websites involving performance, accessibility, technical debt, content updates, integrations, analytics, and long-term maintenance.
 • Develop and support WooCommerce and Shopify experiences, including custom functionality, product content, third-party integrations, analytics, and troubleshooting.
 • Support a headless Shopify storefront built with Hydrogen, React, and TypeScript, including content changes, data troubleshooting, analytics, deployment support, and integration planning.
 • Work directly with clients and agency teams to translate business and marketing needs into practical, maintainable website solutions.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Developer
positions.locationName: Fort Worth, Texas, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Owned front-end development and ongoing technical improvement for custom WordPress and ecommerce websites serving enterprise and mid-market clients.

• Built and maintained custom WordPress websites using PHP, ACF, Bootstrap, JavaScript, SCSS, Elementor, WooCommerce, and reusable theme components.
• Developed flexible templates, component systems, and CMS structures that gave marketing teams greater control over content while preserving design consistency and maintainability.
• Improved Core Web Vitals and site reliability through caching strategy, script optimization, image handling, plugin cleanup, debugging, and front-end performance work.
• Remediated accessibility issues involving semantic structure, keyboard behavior, focus states, heading hierarchy, alternative text, form labeling, and WCAG audit findings.
• Owned development of a custom WooCommerce local-delivery system supporting 23 store locations, thousands of products, delivery-distance rules, product eligibility, cart validation, session data, and order metadata.
• Integrated marketing and analytics platforms including HubSpot, Pardot, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Formstack, SEO tools, and consent-management systems.
• Supported launches, redesigns, maintenance, accessibility work, performance improvements, and feature development across as many as 12 active client accounts.
• Partnered with designers, marketers, SEO specialists, project managers, account teams, and client stakeholders to scope, build, test, launch, and improve website projects.
• Used AI-assisted development tools to accelerate research, troubleshooting, documentation, code generation, and experimentation while maintaining human review and established engineering practices.

positions.title: User Experience Developer
positions.description:
Built the foundation of my agency development career across responsive front-end development, CMS implementation, campaign delivery, website maintenance, quality assurance, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Built and maintained responsive websites, page templates, landing pages, campaign pages, forms, and reusable components using WordPress, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, PHP, and CMS-specific template systems.
• Implemented content, design updates, and website improvements across WordPress, Drupal, Concrete5, HubSpot CMS, Webflow, Shopify, WooCommerce, and OpenCart.
• Produced landing pages and digital campaign experiences across dozens of client accounts in support of lead generation, gated content, service promotions, product launches, and brand initiatives.
• Translated design and content requirements into responsive, production-ready website experiences with attention to usability, accessibility, browser behavior, content accuracy, and long-term maintainability.
• Supported browser testing, quality assurance, website maintenance, content migrations, troubleshooting, plugin updates, and post-launch improvements.
• Collaborated with designers, content teams, SEO and paid media specialists, strategists, analytics teams, project managers, account teams, developers, and client stakeholders.
• Progressed from campaign and production development into ownership of larger custom builds, complex website functionality, and long-term client relationships, leading to promotion to Senior Front-End Developer.
